title: Program-specific region, structured writer output v1
description: What the AI writer must return (strict JSON schema, enforced by the provider). The prototype adds runId, validation flags and provenance on its own side; the writer is never trusted to report those.

replacement_region.description: The one paragraph that replaces (or is inserted at) the authorized region.

segments.description: The paragraph split into consecutive pieces. Every program_fact piece must cite allowed fact ids.
